name: Zhi E Ling de Ni
source:
The scorching summer air buzzes with the cries of cicadas—sharp, oppressive, and almost conspiratorial.
My assistant Ashari and I received a mysterious email from someone calling herself the “Snow White of the Clocktower.”
She offered a generous sum to bring us to the far-off city of Arlan to investigate a string of deadly spirit-related murders.
Night is falling. The prey has yet to appear...
And so, our story quietly begins—on the very first evening of our arrival in Arlan City.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3688470/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
炎热的夏日空气中弥漫着蝉鸣的声音——尖锐、压抑、近乎阴谋。
我和我的助理Ashari收到了一封神秘电子邮件，来自一个自称“钟楼白雪公主”的人。
她慷慨解囊，带我们前往遥远的阿兰市，调查一系列与精神有关的致命谋杀案。
夜幕降临了。猎物还没有出现……
就这样，我们的故事悄然开始了——从抵达阿兰市的第一天晚上开始。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3688470/]Steam[/url]]
